ui.title: Java Roadmap
ui.intro: 4 phases, 56 steps. Kisi bhi topic ka Details button dabao aur jo seekh liya use done mark karo.

phases.title: Phase 1: Java Fundamentals
phases.milestone: Apne basic Java programs khud likh paoge.
topics: Java kya hai, features aur uses
Java ek object-oriented, platform-independent language hai. Android apps, banking software, web backend aur enterprise systems me use hoti hai. Isme 'Write Once, Run Anywhere' ka idea hai.
JDK = code likhne aur compile karne ke tools. JRE = program chalane ka environment. JVM = bytecode ko machine par run karta hai. Flow: .java, compiler, .class (bytecode), JVM.
public static void main(String[] args) se program shuru hota hai. System.out.println() se output milta hai. Compile: javac Hello.java, Run: java Hello.
Variable data ko memory me store karta hai, jaise int age = 20;. Value kabhi change na ho to final keyword use karo.
Primitive: byte, short, int, long, float, double, char, boolean. Non-primitive: String, Arrays, Classes. Har type ki apni memory size aur range hoti hai.
Implicit (chhota se bada): int se double apne aap. Explicit (bada se chhota): int x = (int) 9.7; isme data loss ho sakta hai.
Arithmetic: + - * / %. Relational: == != > <. Logical: && || !. Iske alawa assignment (+=) aur increment (++) operators bhi hote hain.
import java.util.Scanner; phir new Scanner(System.in) banao aur sc.nextInt(), sc.nextLine() se user se input lo.
Condition true ho to ek code chalta hai, warna dusra. if, else if, else ka chain use hota hai. Nested if aur ternary operator bhi seekho.
Ek value ko kai cases se compare karna ho to switch use karo. Har case ke baad break lagana mat bhulna, aur default case rakho.
Kaam baar-baar karne ke liye. for: jab count pata ho. while: jab condition par depend ho. do-while: kam se kam ek baar zaroor chalta hai. break aur continue bhi seekho.
Nested loops ki practice ka best tareeka. Outer loop rows control karta hai, inner loop columns.
Code ko reusable blocks me todna. Parameters input lete hain, return value output deti hai. Overloading: same naam, alag parameters.
Ab sab milake chhote programs banao: calculator, even/odd, prime check, factorial, fibonacci, palindrome number, sum of digits.

phases.title: Phase 2: Arrays & Strings
phases.goal: Data aur text ke saath kaam karna.
phases.milestone: Arrays aur strings par coding problems solve karna.
topics: Ek hi type ke kai elements ek saath store karna: int[] a = new int[5];. Index 0 se shuru hota hai, a.length se size milta hai.
Rows aur columns wali table jaisi structure: int[][] m = new int[3][3];. Matrix problems yahin aate hain.
Array ke har element par loop chalana (for aur for-each). Linear search aur binary search (sorted array par) seekho.
Bubble, selection aur insertion sort. Arrays.sort() ready-made hai, par pehle logic samjho.
String immutable hota hai, yaani ek baar bana to change nahi hota. String pool aur == vs .equals() ka fark samjho.
length(), charAt(), substring(), indexOf(), toUpperCase(), trim(), split(), replace(), equals(), compareTo().
Jab string baar-baar badalni ho to ye use hote hain (mutable). StringBuilder fast hai, StringBuffer thread-safe hai.
Practice karo: reverse, palindrome, anagram, max/min, duplicates, vowel count, second largest.

phases.title: Phase 3: Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs)
phases.goal: Real-world cheezon ko code me model karna.
phases.milestone: OOPs concepts use karke ek chhota Java application banana.
topics: Class ek blueprint hai, object uska real instance. Class me variables (data) aur methods (kaam) hote hain.
Object banate waqt apne aap chalne wala special method. Class ke naam jaisa hota hai, return type nahi hota. Types: default, parameterized, copy.
Current object ko refer karta hai. Mostly tab use hota hai jab parameter aur variable ka naam same ho: this.name = name;
Data ko private rakho aur getters/setters se access do. Isse data safe rehta hai aur control tumhare haath me rehta hai.
Ek class dusri class ki properties use kar sakti hai: extends se. Code reuse hota hai. Types: single, multilevel, hierarchical.
Parent class ke variables, methods aur constructor ko access karne ke liye: super, super.method(), super().
Same class me same naam ke methods, par alag parameters. Ye compile-time polymorphism hai.
Child class parent ke method ko apne tareeke se dobara likhti hai. Same naam aur parameters, @Override annotation use karo.
Ek cheez, kai roop. Compile-time (overloading) aur runtime (overriding). Parent reference se child object: Animal a = new Dog();
Sirf zaroori cheezein dikhana, andar ki detail chhupana. Java me abstract class aur interface se hota hai.
abstract keyword se banti hai, object nahi ban sakta. Isme abstract methods (bina body) aur normal methods dono ho sakte hain.
Sirf rules (methods) define karta hai, class unhe implement karti hai. Ek class kai interfaces implement kar sakti hai.
public (sab ko), private (sirf class ke andar), protected (package aur child), default (sirf package).
static class ka hota hai, object ka nahi. final: variable change nahi, method override nahi, class extend nahi ho sakti.
Classes ko folders ki tarah organize karna. package aur import keywords. java.util, java.io built-in packages hain.
Sab kuch milake ek app banao: Library ya Bank system. Classes, inheritance, interface aur encapsulation use karo.

phases.title: Phase 4: Core Java Advanced
phases.milestone: Collections, files aur multithreading ke saath real applications banana.
topics: Program crash hone se bachana. Checked exceptions compile time par check hoti hain, unchecked runtime par aati hain. throw aur throws seekho.
try me risky code, catch me error handle, finally me wo code jo hamesha chalega (jaise file band karna). Multiple catch bhi likh sakte ho.
Apni khud ki exception class banao: class AgeException extends Exception. Business rules lagane me kaam aata hai.
Primitive ke object versions: Integer, Double, Character, Boolean. Autoboxing aur unboxing seekho.
Type-safe code likhna: ArrayList<String>. Galat type daalne par compile time par hi error aa jata hai.
Data store karne ki ready-made structures. Hierarchy: Collection, phir List, Set aur Queue. Map alag hota hai.
ArrayList: fast access wali dynamic array. LinkedList: insert/delete fast.
Set me duplicates allow nahi. HashSet: unordered aur fast. TreeSet: sorted order me rakhta hai.
Key-value pairs store karta hai. HashMap fast hai, TreeMap keys ko sorted rakhta hai.
Collection ke elements ko ek-ek karke access karna: hasNext(), next(), remove().
Custom objects ko sort karne ke liye. Comparable: class ke andar default order. Comparator: bahar se alag-alag sorting logic.
File create, read, write karna. File, FileReader, FileWriter, BufferedReader aur Scanner ka use.
Object ko bytes me badalke save karna aur wapas padhna. Class ko Serializable implement karni hoti hai.
Ek saath kai kaam chalana. Thread extend karo ya Runnable implement karo. start(), run(), sleep(), join().
Jab kai threads ek hi data use karein to conflict rokna. synchronized keyword aur locks. Race condition samjho.
Chhota anonymous function: (a, b) -> a + b. Functional interfaces ke saath use hota hai.
Collections par filter, map, sorted, collect jaise operations: list.stream().filter(x -> x > 10).
Modern date handling: LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, Period, Duration aur DateTimeFormatter.
